name: pip_wrapper: weather adapter fetch returns valid FeedResult
notes: raw_value.temp_f must be a number (Celsius-to-Fahrenheit conversion from mock main.temp).
raw_value.observed_at must be RFC 3339 UTC ms derived from mock dt (Unix epoch seconds).
value_hash = sha256(JCS(raw_value)) computed by the adapter.
source_url must strip the API key query param before placing in FeedResult.source_url.
FeedResult.raw_value is a JCS-canonical JSON string, not a parsed object.

name: pip_wrapper: weather adapter upstream 5xx returns source_unavailable error
notes: Gate fails closed on source_unavailable for weather per spec Section 2.6.
A denial receipt is emitted; no oracle value is cited (unavailable).
Spec Section 2.6: partial citation for source_unavailable uses raw_value={error:'source_unavailable'}.

name: pip_wrapper: OFAC adapter no-match returns valid FeedResult with match empty
notes: S1.4: raw_value now includes 'matched' boolean and optional 'matched_record' per deliverable 4.
match: [] (empty array) means no SDN hit. Invocation receipt is emitted.
source_url must use vault:// scheme when the gate reads from an offline snapshot.
raw_value.query carries the recipient name (PII); tenant-scoped storage required.

name: pip_wrapper: OFAC adapter match found returns valid FeedResult with match populated
notes: S1.4: raw_value now includes 'matched' boolean and optional 'matched_record' per deliverable 4.
match contains SDN entry hashes, not the full SDN entries.
Gate emits a denial receipt when OFAC match is non-empty.
source_cursor in the FeedResult must carry the list_version.

name: pip_wrapper: time adapter returns valid FeedResult
notes: subject_value is the IANA timezone string, mirrored into raw_value.tz.
source_url is always 'system:monotonic-clock' for the time adapter.
fetched_at must equal raw_value.now_utc (gate-recorded at moment of read).

name: pip_wrapper: webhook adapter http kind returns valid FeedResult (allow:true)
notes: Response body is NOT in raw_value; only response_body_hash is cited (PII boundary).
status_code_or_eval_result is a number (200) for http kind.
request_body_hash = sha256(JSON payload POSTed to webhook URL).
response_body_hash = sha256(raw response text); binds signed receipt to the actual response.
called_at = RFC 3339 UTC ms timestamp of the POST.
url = the webhook subject_value (for audit trail).
Plaintext http:// subject_value must be rejected (TLS required per spec Section 1.8).

name: pip_wrapper: webhook adapter http kind returns valid FeedResult (allow:false / deny path)
notes: Adapter returns ok=true regardless of allow value; the gate acts on allow.
The signed receipt cites response_body_hash which is bound to the {allow:false} body.
The verifier can independently confirm the response body was {allow:false}.

name: pip_wrapper: webhook adapter returns source_unavailable on HTTP 5xx
notes: Non-2xx HTTP status returns source_unavailable.
Gate fails closed on source_unavailable.

name: pip_wrapper: webhook adapter returns source_format_drift on non-JSON response
notes: Non-JSON response body returns source_format_drift.
Gate fails closed; denial receipt emitted.

name: pip_wrapper: webhook adapter returns source_format_drift on wrong response shape
notes: Response JSON missing required {allow: boolean} returns source_format_drift.
Gate fails closed; denial receipt emitted.

name: pip_wrapper: webhook adapter rejects plaintext http URL
notes: Spec Section 1.8: reject plaintext HTTP for any non-system: and non-vault:// source_url.
Gate fails closed: denial receipt with feed_policy_decline.
This is the TLS enforcement boundary test.

name: pip_wrapper: FeedResult value_hash verified by gate before receipt sign
description: The gate recomputes sha256(JCS(JSON.parse(feed_result.raw_value))) and compares to feed_result.value_hash before signing the receipt.
notes: This is the gate self-check at the adapter boundary per spec Section 2.5.
A mismatch is a programmer error in the adapter.
Gate fails closed: denial receipt with cited reason adapter_value_hash_mismatch.
The correct hash for this raw_value is sha256:7c3ad7bd23c7d62f55d90ca54bcd05d832b5f58c5893f463efcbde9e436b264a.

name: pip_wrapper: sms_hitl adapter returns FeedResult for outbound send
notes: Transport pivot: Twilio -> AWS End User Messaging (S2.1 Sprint 2).
The adapter exposes outbound-send + inbound-await as one logical fetch.
FeedResult.raw_value reflects the inbound reply (direction: in), not the outbound.
source_url uses aws-sms:<inboundMessageId> scheme (was Twilio API URL before pivot).
to is E.164 PII; tenant-scoped storage required per spec Section 1.8.

name: pip_wrapper: webhook adapter returns source_unavailable on 10-second HTTP timeout
notes: The webhook adapter has a 10-second timeout per spec Section 2.6.
DEMO_PREWORK_SCHEMAS_2026-06-17.md Section 2 feed-error variant table is explicit:
source-unavailable(string) covers 'upstream 5xx, DNS, timeout'. There is no
separate feed_timeout variant anywhere in the WIT feed-error union or the
gateway's FeedError type (gap/pip/types.ts) -- this vector previously named a
kind that was never part of the spec or the shipped type.
When the upstream does not respond within 10 seconds the adapter must return
{ ok: false, error_kind: 'source_unavailable' }.
The gate fails closed on source_unavailable for the webhook subject_type: a
denial receipt is emitted.
Falsifiability: remove the timeout or extend it indefinitely. The mock upstream
never responds; the adapter hangs and never returns an error.
The vector will time out in the runner and fail with a different error.

name: pip_wrapper: webhook in-browser eval path: snippet_hash binding is end-to-end verified
notes: For in-browser eval, the adapter must bind the snippet_hash into raw_value so
the signed receipt proves which code ran in the browser.
raw_value.response_body_hash = sha256(JCS(eval_result)).
raw_value must carry the snippet_hash field so verifiers can confirm the script.
Falsifiability: omit snippet_hash from raw_value. The shape assertion
snippet_hash_bound_in_raw_value fails because raw_value has no snippet_hash key.
Spec reference: S2.2 webhook adapter in-browser eval; snippet_hash binding contract.

name: pip_wrapper: webhook in-browser eval response shape validation rejects non-boolean allow
notes: In-browser eval result must be { allow: boolean }. A string 'yes' is not a boolean.
The adapter must validate the response shape and return source_format_drift on mismatch.
Falsifiability: coerce any truthy value to true. The gate accepts 'yes' as allow=true
and emits an allow receipt. The expected_result_ok=false assertion fails.
Spec reference: S2.2 webhook adapter response shape contract.
